# system-prompt-leak-detector

> Detect system prompt leakage in LLM outputs: canary tokens, verbatim word n-gram overlap and base64-encoded copies, with a score, signals and an event hook that never sees the text. Python package `trysac-system-prompt-leak-detector`, import name `system_prompt_leak_detector`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
